headline: Heard appeal of trespass order and discussed changes to appeal hearing process
summary: The committee received fire and police department reports with no action taken. It heard testimony from Todd DeLuca and Daniel Pecor on a trespass order appeal before moving to a deliberative session. The committee also discussed possible changes to the ordinance governing appeal hearings but took no action.

5.   Appeal of Trespass Order/Hearing 
     5.01  In re: Matter of Todd DeLuca 
 
The Committee heard from Todd DeLuca as well as Daniel Pecor of Chocolate Thunder, 
represented by City Attorney Jessica Brown. The Committee had the opportunity to ask 
questions of both parties before moving to Deliberative Session. 
    
6.  Appeal Hearing Proceedings Discussion 
     6.01 A committee discussion on how to better formalize the appeal hearing process 
 
The Committee discussed possible changes to the ordinance for the appeal process and the 
hearing format and protocol.  No action was taken.
